name: @office/app-sdk
description: Office marketplace App SDK (OFF-025): the versioned AppManifest schema with fail-closed total validation, A9 permission declarations and lifecycle records (explicit, versioned, revocable), command bindings validated against the OFF-017 action vocabulary, event subscriptions, typed extension UI descriptors (an app never ships executable code in its manifest), app contract dependencies, and the in-memory registry/validators used by tests. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/authz, @office/domain-kernel, and the TYPE-ONLY surface of @office/actions — an importing app's runtime graph stays contracts/authz/domain-kernel.
